title: add benchmark runners reporting pipeline
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: The benchmark lab currently runs representative workloads and produces raw JSON artifacts, but there is no standardized pipeline to aggregate results, compute baselines, and push summary reports to the observability dashboard. This PR introduces a reporting pipeline and a lightweight runner wrapper to produce consistent output that can be consumed by the dashboard and daily perf jobs. Changes include: - a new reporting service (benchmark-lab/reporting) that ingests run artifacts from S3, computes aggregated metrics (p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/sec, memory usage, cost estimate), and publishes summarized JSON + Prometheus metrics; - a runner wrapper (benchmark-lab/runner/wrapper.py) that standardizes artifact layout, uploads intermediate artifacts to S3, and emits a run-manifest used by the reporting service; - CI integration: new GH workflow (.github/workflows/bench-report.yml) which runs a smoke bench, uploads a test artifact to a test S3 bucket, and validates the reporting output; - docs: README and runbook for using the pipeline and troubleshooting; - small infra config: S3 policy, IAM role for the reporting job, and a CloudWatch -> Prometheus exporter shim used in staging. Checklist: - [x] runner wrapper implementation - [x] reporting service ingest and aggregation - [x] end-to-end smoke test in CI - [x] docs and runbook - [x] IAM policy and infra snippets - [x] perf baselines updated Context: This was driven by ENG-7124 (need automated daily baselines) and ENG-7130 (dashboard quality improvements). The design favors reproducibility and small outputs (summary JSONs ~<50KB) so the dashboard ingestion is low-cost. Backwards compatibility: existing raw artifacts are still stored and can be read by the reporting service; the runner wrapper is optional for older runs. Testing: unit tests for aggregation logic included (benchmark-lab/reporting/tests/test_aggregation.py), integration smoke in CI that runs a short Llama-like workload using the local runner, and an end-to-end test that validates the published Prometheus metrics. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy reporting service to staging for two days, run nightly daily-baseline job, then roll to prod. Release notes: Adds a reporting pipeline for benchmark-lab that aggregates run results and publishes summary JSON and Prometheus metrics. See README for usage.
